properties.name: Effectiveness
properties.definition:
Effectiveness, represented as ratio.

Ratio of the change in dry bulb temperature of the (primary) air stream to the difference between the entering dry bulb temperature of the (primary) air and the wet-bulb temperature of the (secondary) air.

properties.name: SensibleHeatTransferRate
properties.definition:
Sensible heat transfer rate.

Sensible heat transfer rate to primary air flow.

properties.name: LatentHeatTransferRate
properties.definition:
Latent heat transfer rate.

To primary air flow.

propertySets.name: Pset_EvaporativeCoolerTypeCommon
propertySets.definition:
Evaporative cooler type common attributes.
Sound attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead. WaterRequirement attribute unit type modified in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: FlowArrangement
properties.definition:
Defines the basic flow arrangements for the heat exchanger or cooler tower:COUNTERFLOW: Air and water flow enter in different directions.
CROSSFLOW: Air and water flow are perpendicular.
PARALLELFLOW: Air and water flow enter in same directions.
MULTIPASS: Multipass flow heat exchanger arrangement. 
OTHER: Other type of heat exchanger flow arrangement not defined above.

properties.name: OperationTemperatureRange
properties.definition: Allowable operation ambient air temperature range.

properties.name: EffectivenessTable
properties.definition: Total heat transfer effectiveness curve as a function of the primary air flow rate.

properties.name: AirPressureDropCurve
properties.definition: Air pressure drop as a function of air flow rate.

properties.name: WaterPressDropCurve
properties.definition: Water pressure drop as function of water flow rate.

propertySets.name: Qto_EvaporativeCoolerBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of evaporative coolers.
